operations.input: title, props or shotPlan, audio, sources and actual provenance JSON.
operations.action: Read-only preflight; freeze matching files/runtime and idempotent request.
operations.completion: Exact voice sample clock, ordered captions, real media/presenter windows, source identities and loaded font metrics pass.
operations.recovery: Repair the affected input or restore original hashes; preserve upstream paid results.

operations.input: Frozen request plus existing global local-recompose queue.
operations.action: VideoCompose/Remotion, CBR export and technical checks; produce primary and no-BGM alternative.
operations.output: H2641440x1800/30fps>=20Mbps; AAC48k stereo; quality/result/delivery records; candidate work version.
operations.completion: Expected frames/duration, full decode, measured bitrate and<=-1.5dBTP; separate actual visual/listening/lip/user gates remain.
operations.recovery: Resume original --request without regenerating voice/avatar; changed incomplete runtime requires new freeze.

operations.input: Actual complete encoded outputs and exact source-bound inputs.
operations.action: Inspect boundaries, in-flight/hold states, source full-frame layout, caption reading and presenter clocks; watch/listen separately.
operations.output: Dimension-specific evidence and ready scope with input/output hashes.
operations.completion: Current source/technical/visual evidence supports scope; unperformed continuous audio/device/user review retains pending.
operations.recovery: Identify element and global frame; repair source-owned input/implementation and rerun affected checks.
